The beetles exhibit the characteristic metallic reddish-bronze and cream/white coloration with distinct patterns on their elytra. They appear to be interacting closely, possibly mating or aggregating. The lighting is bright, casting sharp shadows, highlighting the iridescent sheen of their exoskeletons.
